jobs.occupation: Research Associate / Postdoc (m/f/d) in the field of Cryogenic Quantum Electronics (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
With around 15.000 students and 3.800 employees, the Technische Universität Braunschweig is one of Germany’s leading institutes of technology. It stands for strategic and performance-oriented thinking and acting, relevant research, committed teaching, and the successful transfer of knowledge and technologies to the economy and society. We consistently advocate for family friendliness and equal opportunities.

Our research focuses are mobility, engineering for health, metrology, and city of the future. Strong engineering and natural sciences are our core disciplines. These are closely interconnected with economics, social and educational sciences and humanities. Our campus is located in the midst of one of the most research-intensive regions in Europe. We work successfully together with over 20 research institutions in our neighborhood as we do with our international partner universities.

The Division of Cryogenic Quantum Electronics, led by Prof. Dr. Oleksandr Dobrovolskiy, investigates fascinating physical phenomena governing the dynamics of magnetic and superconducting systems and develops quantum electronic devices based on these principles. Its research bridges materials science, experimental physics, electrical measurement science, and metrology. To strengthen the research group and advance its cutting-edge research in cryogenic quantum electronics, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d)
(EG13 TV-L, full time - fixed term)

with demonstrated expertise in experimental low-temperature physics.
The position is to be filled on a fixed-term basis for an initial period of 2 years. The successful applicant will be given the opportunity to pursue a further scientific qualification (habilitation).

Your tasks

- You will carry out research in the area of cryogenic and quantum electronics, with a focus on experiments at mK temperatures.
- You will apply for and work on research projects.
- You will perform measurements in a dilution refrigerator and other cryogenic setups, develop, build and optimize cryogenic measurement platforms.
- You will publish research findings in leading international journals and participate in national and international conferences.
- You will be involved in teaching at the University (preparation and implementation of courses as well as supervision of students’ work).

Your Qualifications

- You hold a completed university degree at Master’s level or equivalent, as well as a completed PhD in a field relevant to the position (e.g. physics, electrical engineering, materials science, or a related field), and ideally have postdoctoral research experience.
- You have experience with low-temperature experiments, ideally involving dilution refrigerators in the fields of superconductivity and/or magnetism, as well as good programming skills (e.g., Python, LabVIEW).
- You have knowledge of superconducting and/or magnetic devices, high-frequency and microwave engineering, nanotechnology, and/or quantum measurement techniques, or you are willing and able to acquire this expertise quickly.
- You have excellent English language skills; knowledge of German is desirable.
- You are flexible, can perform under pressure and work well in a team.

We offer

- work on exciting future-oriented research topics in an inspiring work environment as part of the university community
- A vibrant campus life in an international atmosphere with lots of intercultural offers and international cooperations
- Pay in accordance with the collective agreement TV-L (a special payment at the end of the year as well as a supplementary benefit in the form of a company pension, comparable to a company pension in the private sector) including 30 days' vacation per year
- flexible working and part-time options and a family-friendly university culture, awarded the "Family-friendly university" audit since 2007
- special continuing education programs for young scientists, a postdoc program, as well as other offerings from the Central Personnel Development Department and sports activities.

Further notes
We welcome applicants of all nationalities. At the same time, we encourage people with severe disabilities to apply. Applications from severely disabled persons will be given preference if they are equally qualified. Please attach a proof of disability to your application. We are also working on the fulfilment of the Central Equality Plan based on the Lower Saxony Equal Rights Act (Niedersächsisches Gleichberechtigungsgesetz—NGG) and strive to reduce under-representation in all areas and positions as defined by the NGG. Therefore, applications from women are particularly welcome in this case.

The personal data will be stored for the purpose of processing the application. By submitting your application, you agree that your data may be stored and processed electronically for application purposes in compliance with the provisions of data protection law. Further information on data protection can be found in our data protection regulations at https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/datenschutzerklaerung-bewerbungen (https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/datenschutzerklaerung-bewerbungen) .

Application costs cannot be reimbursed.

Deadline for applications is 31.10.2026.

Please send your application via email to oleksandr.dobrovolskiy@tu-braunschweig.de (https://mailto:oleksandr.dobrovolskiy@tu-braunschweig.de) with the following documents in the PDF-format:

• Cover letter
• Curriculum vitae (CV)
• List of publications
• Brief summary of previous research / third-party projects (2 pages)
• Doctoral degree certificate
• Names of two references

Contact
Prof. Dr. Oleksandr Dobrovolskiy
Cryogenic Quantum Electronics
Institute for Electrical Measurement Science
and Fundamental Electrical Engineering
Hans-Sommer-Str. 66
38106 Braunschweig, Germany

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for

Vertragsjurist / Procurement Contracts Manager (d/m/w)

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Procurement Contracts Manager (m/f) to join our "Procurement Contracts department" dedicated to the Space Systems Business line. The successful candidate will be based in Bremen, Germany.

Are you ready to shape the future of aerospace and defense? Join our diverse, international team of 30+ Contract Managers and become a vital part of our Air Power, Space, and Connected Intelligence divisions. Join a dedicated team that acts every day true to the global Airbus purpose: “We pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world”.

Here, you won't just manage contracts, you will provide the strategic expertise that powers our Procurement function and supports the development of next-generation Space Systems for global commercial and governmental customers. You will work at the intersection of innovation and execution, collaborating closely with experts in Sales, Finance, Legal, and Export Control.

If you are looking for a high-impact role in a supportive, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you.

** Your Location**

Bremen is a charming, historic city in the northwest of Germany. It is not only one of the greenest cities in the country, but also offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. The city is also a great place for coastal lovers, as it is only a one-hour drive away from the North Sea coast.

** Our Benefits for you**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive salary and individual additional benefits, e.g. company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g. bicycle leasing) or employee advantages at cooperating companies in accordance with our valid guidelines.
- Time for you (and your relatives): 30 days of annual leave according to the collective agreement (35h/week); compatibility of family & career (flextime, mobile working, part-time, job sharing, sabbatical).
- Easy Progression: Excellent further training opportunities and international, group-wide development perspectives.
- Well-being at work: Company doctor; comprehensive health offers (sports courses, prevention offers, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, partly near-site kindergarten.
- Diversity connects: Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, support and diversity are lived.

** Your Tasks and Responsibilities**

- Act as the Procurement Contract Manager (“PCM”) Focal Point for applicable Space Systems business activities and programs, mainly in Germany,
- Provide the support and drive your advice of Call for Tenders (CFTs) by challenging/assessing/approving the contractual baselines, assessing the contractual elements of bids, preparing/supporting the negotiations and overseeing the contract awards,
- Prepare, perform and lead contract drafting and negotiations in close collaboration with the Procurement function,
- Approve and sign the Contract Validation Form (CVF) ensuring all key elements - including executive summaries, deviations, risks, and opportunities - are accurately captured and approved, prior to any Airbus final signature,
- Hand in hands with the Procurement function, oversee and manage the contract lifecycle, including: preparation, drafting and negotiation of complex contracts, amendments, claims and settlement agreements, and other key contractual documents,
- Mitigate contractual risks by providing contractual expert analysis and advice during disagreements or potential disputes between Airbus and our partners, suppliers,
- Provide support for the preparation/defense of claims and pre-litigation matters,
- Provide cross-functional expertise in contract design, drafting, and negotiation for Airbus departments outside of the Procurement function,
- Advise internal stakeholders on the contractual implications of strategic projects, specifically, but not only, regarding confidentiality and Intellectual Property (IP),
- Develop new and further development of existing Procurement Academy training; coaching and training-on-the-job of our stakeholders in the areas of contracts management and negotiations,
- In the objectives to enhance performance and agility, standardize procurement excellence by proposing, drafting and revising standard contracts that integrate economic, commercial, technological, legal, and risk management requirements.

** Required Skills and Qualifications**

- You hold a successfully completed university degree (Master's level) in Legal and/or Business Administration or equivalent, with experience in Contact Management, Business Law, or a comparable experience.
- You possess a good experience in Contract Management as well as in the legally secure drafting and design of procurement agreements (3+ years).
- You communicate at a fully negotiation-proof level in German and have fluent English language skills to cooperate effectively in an international context. German language is mandatory.
- Your are open-minded, self-motivated team-player, you provide a “Can Do” attitude who enjoys finding solutions to contractual issues / challenges,
- You are Customer oriented, with excellent communication and collaboration skills,
- Analytical and rigorous, able to break-down and explain complex topics to a variety of stakeholders,
- Pragmatic, able to balance contractual and business risks, priorities, oversights and compliance,
- Willing to take on big and small tasks, ranging from operational support to strategic projects.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal development with tailored development solutions. Take your career to the next level and apply online now!

​Join the Fuselage Structure Analysis team in Hamburg as a technical anchor in our newly integrated "One Fuselage" domain. As the Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) Engineer for Primary Structure, you will will have the chance of contributing to the structural integrity, driving the F&DT justification for critical fuselage components across the entire aircraft lifecycle—from next-generation design and certification to manufacturing and global fleet support.

You will grow into a technical expert, collaborating with a high-level network to integrate advanced simulations and structural health strategies. We are looking for a motivated, curious engineer driven by a "People First" spirit to help us create the future of aerospace excellence.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

At Worldline, our technology addresses persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. If you are a highly-skilled Tax director, specialized in German and Swiss tax, then get ready to join our company.

This role will report to the Group Head of Tax.

Day-to-day responsibilities

As a Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe, which include main entities notably in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Poland, you will be in charge of all the tax aspects related to this perimeter that can evolve depending on the activity. You will be the key contact and stakeholder of local accounting, controlling, legal and finances teams, as well as the main interlocutor for local tax authorities. You will also work closely with the group tax team in order to ensure proper implementation of group tax policy and strategy.

Your key responsibilities include:

- Manage tax aspects of subsidiaries mainly in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Poland (including country-specific tax structuring, transfer pricing compliance, limitation of interest deductibility, and local tax consolidation group) and compliance aspects, as CIT, VAT, local taxes returns and ensure compliance with local regulations.
- Support local finance teams for annual financial statements under IFRS and local accounting rules (German HGB, Austrian UGB, Swiss GAAP); ensure correct and optimal application of IFRS, translating IFRS and tax standards into practical processes used across administrations.
- Take ownership of tax processes at Group level for the Tax Cluster area and ensure coordination between local teams, Group Finance, and external advisors (including transfer pricing documentation, foreign tax credits, local incentives, and subsidies)
- Provide advice and support to group tax team, finance, legal and operational teams on  tax matters including CIT, VAT, and country-specific taxes and compliance requirements. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Conduct tax monitoring across the Tax Cluster perimeter, build local tax manuals and guides that are user friendly and understandable to a larger audience; train local finance and tax teams when required
- Ensure management of tax audits and litigations as well as relationships with tax authorities in each jurisdiction: prepare, coordinate and validate responses (with support from external advisors if necessary).
- Anticipate and assess tax risks across the Tax cluster perimeter, considering local regulatory changes and multi-country implications and work closely with group tax team in this respect. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Support the group and local finance teams on reporting (budget/actuals/forecast), on the determination of tax results, current and deferred tax charges and VAT recovery ratio across all  Tax Cluster entities, coordinate the tax reporting and tax package process with local stakeholders, automate and improve processes, and harmonize local submissions as appropriate.
- Monitor tax legislation and case law developments and ensure proactive adaptation.

This list is non-exhaustive and is intended to evolve with the position and the person who joins the team.

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow.

- Minimum 12 years of experience within international direct taxation at Big4, international law firm or at a multinational organization; pursued graduation from university (Tax Law or Tax Economics).
- Professional proficiency of English and German is required
- Expert in Excel and good knowledge of reporting tool (SAP)
- You demonstrate expertise in international Group tax matters, leveraging your previous experience.
- You are diligent, independent, proactive, with strong analytical and synthesis abilities, and excellent written communication skills. 
- You take initiative, bring forward strategic proposals, and have strong interpersonal capabilities.
- Knowledge of the payments, eCommerce or FinTech industry is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:

- Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide
- Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career
- An exciting salary
- At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career
- And many more...

#LI-AB1

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. 

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

jobs.occupation: F&DT Lead Engineer for Fuselage Primary Structure (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airframe Engineering, Airbus Operations is looking for a

F&DT Lead Engineer for Fuselage Primary Structure (d/f/m)

Become part of a pioneering team with a strong identity and a shared commitment to delivering best-in-class stress solutions!

Join the Fuselage Structure Analysis team in Hamburg as a technical anchor in our newly integrated "One Fuselage" domain. As the Lead Engineer Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) for Primary Structure, you will be a custodian of structural integrity, driving the F&DT justification for critical fuselage components across the entire aircraft lifecycle—from next-generation design and certification to manufacturing and global fleet support.

You will lead the delivery of mission-critical stress engineering data and shape the departmental strategy for innovation. This is a pivotal role where you will collaborate across a high-level network to integrate advanced simulations and structural health strategies. We are looking for a pioneering engineer driven by a "People First" spirit to help us create the future of aerospace structural excellence.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location - 2 options

Hamburg is home to the largest production site for civil aircraft. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Bremen is one of the country’s greenest cities. It offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead Advanced Structural Analysis: Technically lead the project team for the fatigue and damage tolerance evaluations
- Define Airworthiness & Maintenance Criteria: Establish damage tolerance philosophies, including allowable damage limits, inspection thresholds, and repeat intervals to ensure long-term structural integrity
- Oversee Structural Testing: Plan and analyze fatigue tests across all levels, validating theoretical models with real-world data
- Drive Cross-Functional Certification: Collaborate with Design, Materials, and Stress teams to integrate F&DT requirements into the design phase, ensuring full compliance with regulatory airworthiness standards
- Support Fleet In-Service Solutions: Investigate structural failures and anomalies to determine root causes, while developing and validating effective repair schemes and service bulletins
- Manage Technical Project Deliverables: Define technical scopes, workload sizing, and lead times, ensuring high-quality inputs and the mitigation of technical risks/opportunities
- Strategic Reporting & Governance: Present progress and technical findings in steering ceremonies, providing clear clarification of assumptions and interdependencies to stakeholders
- Continuous Innovation & Method Improvement: Stay at the forefront of industry advancements to improve internal analysis tools, structural health monitoring strategies, and airworthiness limitation frameworks

In essence, you plan, structure, and deliver technical outputs for your area in Time, Cost and Quality. You guide colleagues and provide technical expertise, supported by senior team members.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You hold a Master's degree / Diploma in Engineering or similar qualifications
- You bring several years of experience in Fatigue & Damage Tolerance and associated Process, Methods & Tools
- You are experienced in technically leading employees
- You enjoy working with many interfaces with different knowledge levels and cultural backgrounds adapting your communication accordingly
- You have a creative data-driven mindset and are motivated to improve the way we work and interact with the world around us (e.g. using AI)
- You have the capabilities to interpret the environmental context and influence decision-making within the company
- Experience in Hyperworks and Python would be a plus
- Fluency in English is mandatory, German is appreciated
